summary: D-6 cupola cabin built 1934 on the Spokane Indian Reservation; abandoned 1964; burned in the 2015 Carpenter Road Fire; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Burned in the 2015 Carpenter Road Fire

visit.trail_note: Turn from West End Road about a mile west of Turtle Lake recreation area; the turn is not signed. The trip report describes a dirt road in fair condition for most vehicles, but it predates the fire.

corrections.why: Sources say the cabin burned in the 2015 forest fire. The register's Removed field gives only the year.

resolved_conflicts.field: direction of the Wellpinit tower from Spokane Mountain
resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Willhite put the Wellpinit tower about four miles south; TrailChick says four miles north. The story gives no direction.
The register's Removed field says 2015 and its description says the lookout burned in 2015. The story uses burned.

notes_for_editor: The brief lists access as permission, but no source read states an access rule, so access is left out. Willhite gives drive-up directions only. No source describes the site after the 2015 fire. The brief has no height, and none is in the sources. The Wellpinit direction conflicts between cite 3 and cite 5 and is left out of the story.
